description: Harnessed real run using an n2-standard-16 CPU collector for the official three-trial RecordingCheatCode dataset, followed by LEWM training on the L4 runner if dataset validation passes.

failure.reason: CPU collector bootstrap and participant image build succeeded, but the collection wrapper did not forward AIC_DOCKER_GPUS=0 to the remote VM, so docker refused the model container with a GPU device-driver selection error.

hypothesis: Moving simulator-bound data collection to a larger CPU runner will avoid the g2-standard-4 entity-spawn race while preserving the L4 for training.
notes: No HDF5 dataset was produced. This run exposed and fixed a wrapper contract bug; the next CPU run can reuse the built participant image and omit --gpus correctly.
